Limits are 34.0/36.3 MB, still about 2.3 MB under the build in production before the cuts. The optional briefings Worker (2026-10-28, docs/BRIEFINGS-DESIGN.md) is built like the readers Worker from workers/briefings/index.js: the engine in lib/briefings (66 KB), the shared docdb with its narrowed mingo (500 KB of the 608 KB), the AI key store and three models, no Next.js, React, SES or auth code. The same change adds the BriefingsDelivery entrypoint to the API Worker, loaded only on its first RPC call: lib/briefings-delivery.js is 4.5 KB of the API Worker, which measured 8139972 bytes in the Cloud build with the Briefings actions, under its unchanged 8.15 MB. Briefings (2026-10-28, main 4ffd4e0): the app measured handler 34273082 and upload 36590421 bytes, +524 KB and +533 KB on the sprint wrap. It is the Briefings registry actions and their schemas, AI keys, the briefing, run and AI key pages, the public verdict page and the briefings-bot docs page; the engine is not in the app (it runs in the briefings Worker; the hourly cron imports it only when self-hosted). No dependency was added. Limits 34.5/36.85 MB; trimming the Briefings schemas from the app bundle is the next size task. Subfolder hosting and briefing sections (2026-10-28, main 2e46231): handler 34614985 and upload 36946238 bytes, about +0.34 MB on the Briefings measurement: the mount actions, routing and HTMLRewriter step, the subfolder docs page with its five recipes, and the section editor and run tables. No dependency was added. Limits 34.75/37.1 MB. This is the second raise in a day: the next change to the app must take the Briefings and mount schemas and docs recipes out of the app handler (they are only needed by the API Worker and the public pages) before anything else is added. Mingo ESM (2026-10-28): every bundle now takes mingo's ESM build (scripts/mingo-esm.mjs), so its unused operators drop out: app handler 34,615,958 to 34,003,661 bytes, upload 36,947,202 to 36,125,410, API Worker 7,908,694 to 7,552,868, readers 2,252,348 to 1,898,736, briefings 749,241 to 396,140. Limits unchanged. This replaces the earlier note that Briefings and mount code must leave the app first: measured at about 0.31 MB, they cannot leave it without breaking the dashboard, self-hosting or the public pages render (docs/PERFORMANCE.md). Short chunk names (2026-10-28): scripts/short-chunk-names.mjs, after dedupe-chunks in the build command, gives every server chunk but the runtime and the [externals] chunks a base-36 name, so the 83,507 places the build names a chunk (the loaders' lists of nested async chunking, routes' entries, client reference manifests, OpenNext's modules and requireChunk) are shorter: app handler 34,243,892 to 30,716,983 bytes, upload 36,367,927 to 32,752,997. Nothing else changes (docs/PERFORMANCE.md). Limits unchanged, so the app has 4 MB of room again.
